//: M252 81mm medium mortar. Deploys to a firing furniture; uses 81mm shells. Heavier and longer-ranged than the M224.
description: The M252 is the U.S. military's 81mm medium mortar - a crew-served tube that lobs heavy high-explosive shells far beyond the reach of the lighter 60mm M224.  Deploy it on open ground and, with enough launcher skill to read the firing tables, rain shells on a distant target.

//: Mk 153 Shoulder-Launched Multipurpose Assault Weapon, 83mm, reloadable. Bunker-busting/anti-armor.
description: The Mk 153 SMAW, a reloadable 83mm shoulder-fired rocket launcher used to crack bunkers, breach walls, and kill light armor.  Bulky and heavy, but it reloads in the field unlike a disposable rocket.

//: FGM-148 Javelin: man-portable fire-and-forget top-attack ATGM (CLU + missile). Reloadable.
description: The FGM-148 Javelin, a man-portable anti-tank missile system: a reusable Command Launch Unit mated to a fire-and-forget missile.  Lock on, launch, and move - the missile climbs and dives onto its target's thin top armor on its own.
